items.title: A perfect complex whose cohomology is locally free on a dense open becomes of tor dimension at most one after a suitable admissible blowup
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a scheme X, a perfect object E of D(O_X) and a scheme theoretically dense open U such that every H^i(E|_U) is finite locally free of constant rank r_i, the lemma asserts the existence of a U-admissible blowup b : X' -> X with H^i(Lb^*E) a perfect O_{X'}-module of tor dimension at most 1 for all i (statement lines 13035-13044). The proof works affine locally: representing E|_V by a complex of free modules and setting k_i = r_{i+1} - r_{i+2} + ... + (-1)^{b-i+1} r_b, an explicitly omitted computation gives the rank rho_i of d_i over U cap V as -k_i + n_{i+1} - n_{i+2} + ... + (-1)^{b-i+1} n_b, and the ideal of rho_i by rho_i minors of d_i is introduced (proof lines 13046-13065). The proof then observes that this ideal agrees with the global ideal Fit_{i,k_i}(E), which is independent of the chosen complex by Lemma labelled lemma-fitting-ideals-complex, and also realises it as a Fitting ideal of the cokernel of d_i (proof lines 13067-13075). Blowing X up in the product of the ideals Fit_{i,k_i}(E) dominates each individual blowup b_i by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-blowing-up-two-ideals, each b_i is U-admissible by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-blowup-fitting-ideal, and one further small detail, explicitly omitted and compared with Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-dominate-admissible-blowups, shows that the product blowup is U-admissible (proof lines 13077-13086). After this reduction one may assume the Fitting ideals are invertible; choosing a finite free complex representing E|_V, the cokernels have tor dimension at most 1 by the blowup-of-fitting-ideal lemma, hence both the images and the kernels are finite locally free, and the short exact sequences 0 -> Im(d_{i-1}) -> Ker(d_i) -> H^i(E)|_V -> 0 give the conclusion (proof lines 13088-13103). Locating the right Fitting ideals whose blowup forces tor dimension at most one is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2; the two omitted details are recorded verbatim in the editorial notes.
